cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline documentation assistant for clinicians in low-connectivity settings: turns a spoken or typed dictation into a correctly structured, complete French clinical document (compte-rendu de consultation, lettre de sortie), grounded via local RAG over internal report-format rules so the model follows real hospital document structure rather than inventing one. A deterministic French-Swahili medical term dictionary and sentence templates (no second model, no free-form generation) produce a patient-facing Swahili summary from the same structured facts, for cross-lingual handoff. The tool addresses documentation quality, legibility, and handoff time, not record storage -- paper booklets remain the archival record.

test_prompts.prompt: Redige un compte-rendu de consultation structure pour: patiente de 34 ans, fievre a 39, cephalees depuis 2 jours, pas d'antecedent connu, tension 11/7.

Redige une lettre de sortie pour le patient Benoit: hospitalise 3 jours pour paludisme simple confirme (TDR positif), traite par arthemether-lumefantrine, evolution favorable, apyrexie depuis 48h, sortie ce jour avec traitement complete a domicile, recommandation de revenir en consultation si fievre persiste au-dela de 3 jours.
